versions.changelog:
**Major update: Adds a local narration script + shot plan phase before video rendering.**

- Narration script and shot plan are now drafted locally first, producing a real deliverable users can read and edit before any rendering occurs.
- Only after user approval of the narration plan does the skill prompt to connect and render the MP4 via OnePress.
- Updated description and usage flow to reflect this two-phase process (plan locally, render on OnePress).
- Removes the separate skill card documentation; all usage info consolidated in SKILL.md.
- Enforces: never pretend to render video locally; always clarify production happens on OnePress after the planning phase.

- Documented that cloned voices are now cataloged in the workspace Voices/ folder, with an index listing playable samples.
- Clarified privacy and management details for voice cloning.
- No functional changes to the skill code/API; documentation update only.

onepress-deck-video 1.1.4

- Added support for custom voice narration by uploading a 15–60 second single-speaker sample file for AI voice cloning.
- Updated instructions in SKILL.md to describe the new voice cloning workflow.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Added documentation on voice selection for narration, including language auto-matching and voice override options.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Updated version to 1.1.3.

- Updated skill version to 1.1.2.
- Added PUBLISHING.md for publishing guidance.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Clarified OnePress connection and pairing details in documentation.

- Switch from manual API key entry to secure browser-based OnePress account connection (no key copying required).
- Support for uploading local slide decks to OnePress before video generation.
- Automatically download the completed MP4 video and save it locally for the user.
- Updated instructions and workflow to match OnePress's new pairing and artifact retrieval processes.
- Removed deprecated documentation (skill-card.md) for clarity.

- Updated version to 1.0.2.
- Documentation cleanup: removed outdated skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality.

- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.
- Minor update to SKILL.md: replaced sample curl commands with more concise HTTP request/response blocks.
- No changes to underlying functionality; description and usage remain the same.

Initial release of onepress-deck-video.

- Create narrated explainer videos from slide decks or topics using OnePress.
- Requires ONEPRESS_API_KEY for video generation via the OnePress API.
- Automatically submits tasks, polls for completion, and reports where the MP4 is available in the user's OnePress workspace.
- Clearly communicates errors such as invalid API keys or out-of-credits status.
- Provides usage guidance and links for getting started and retrieving API keys.
